shadows.name: now-marker

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All UI movement: press, lift, indicator slide.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback: buttons and nav links 0.97, brand 0.95, copy 0.96, side cards 0.99.

motion.name: color

motion.name: card-lift

motion.name: nav-indicator

motion.purpose: Royal indicator sliding to the current section; fade only under reduced motion.

motion.name: copy-swap
motion.value: 120ms label swap, 200ms blur(2px) and opacity 0.4; reverts after 1800ms

motion.name: mist-drift
motion.purpose: Canvas mist; paused offscreen, static under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Grids collapse to one column; nav spans full width; role dates stack.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: 18px gutters, 1rem body, nav edge-fade masks, header actions split the row.

mist.shape: Radial-gradient ellipse, canvas height 30% of width, squashed vertically to about 30% (0.85-1.15 jitter); stops: 0 full, 0.45 at 55%, 1 transparent.
mist.notes: Sizes are fractions of min(viewport width, 1600px), x1.6 under 600px wide. Device pixel ratio capped at 1.5. Speed in px per second.

navEdgeFade.appliesAt: 520px and below, toggled by the links' scroll position

narrative.overview:
The page is read like a sky at the end of the day: it opens on a navy-to-royal header, settles into a warm cream reading field for the résumé itself, and closes on the night sky again behind the contact card. Professional comes first. The sky is atmosphere, never decoration; its only motion is a faint band of mist low in the header and one more under the contact card, so pale and slow that it reads as air rather than as an illustration.

Everything that carries information sits on lifted paper cards with tight corners and soft, navy-tinted shadows. The palette is the owner's six colours, used by role and never swapped: navy is ink and the dark grounds, royal marks structure and the current place, cream is the ground, magenta is the only colour that means "act", plum quietly marks dates and labels, and gray draws the hairlines. Type pairs an editorial grotesk for headings with a clean, friendly sans for reading. Density is calm: generous section spacing, short line lengths, nothing competing with the facts.

The botanical and aloha motifs of an earlier pass, and the bright midday-blue cloudy pass after it, were rejected by the owner; this system replaces both.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-to-royal sky at the top, navy again at the close, cream reading field between.
Mist drawn on canvas: wide, flat, soft-edged ellipses at 7-11% alpha, low in the header and one band near the footer.
Paper cards (6-12px corners, never pills) with soft navy shadows.
Magenta for actions only; plum for dates and labels; royal for structure and "you are here".
A royal indicator slides under the current section in a floating paper nav bar.
Schibsted Grotesk headings at heavy weights with tight tracking; Figtree body.

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Magenta means "you can act here" or "this is live" (primary button, card arrows, focus ring, copied, Now). It is never body text, never a heading, never a decorative fill.

rules.name: The Plum Is Meta Rule
rules.body: Plum marks when and what-kind: dates, years and contact keys. If a piece of text is neither a date nor a label, it is not plum.

rules.name: The Royal Is Structure Rule
rules.body: Royal marks where you are and what holds the page together: the nav indicator, rules, key figures, links. It is not an action colour; actions go to magenta.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels, no letter-spaced kickers. Hierarchy comes from the grotesk's weight and size, not from small caps above headings.

rules.name: The Tabular Dates Rule
rules.body: Every date, year and time uses tabular lining numerals so columns of years align.

rules.name: The Quiet Mist Rule
rules.body: Mist is cream at 7-11% alpha, drawn as wide, flat, soft-edged ellipses (height 30% of width, then squashed again to about 30%) that drift linearly at 3-5px per second. In the header it lives in two layers between 76% and 102% of the header's height, behind the side cards; at the close it is a single band at 94-106%, under the contact card. It never sits behind the name or intro, pauses offscreen, and is static under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Navy Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted navy (or magenta, for the action glow). No neutral black shadows, no hard offsets.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: No element uses a full-height radius. Even the sliding nav indicator is an 8px rectangle.

dos: **Do** keep the six owner colours on their roles: navy ink and dark grounds, royal structure, cream ground, magenta actions, plum dates and labels, gray hairlines.
**Do** put every block of content on a paper card with 10px corners and the resting navy shadow.
**Do** keep mist cream at 7-11% alpha, flat and soft-edged, in the lower header and one band near the footer, drifting at 3-5px per second and still under reduced motion.
**Do** run UI transitions under 260ms on cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), with press feedback (scale 0.95-0.99) on every control.
**Do** set dates and years in plum, weight 600, with tabular lining numerals.
**Do** gate hover styles behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
donts: **Don't** use magenta for text emphasis, headings or decoration; it is reserved for actions and live state.
**Don't** use pills or full-height radii anywhere, including the nav indicator.
**Don't** let mist sit behind the name or intro, brighten past 11% alpha, or take on puffy, lobed cloud illustration shapes in the page.
**Don't** reintroduce botanical or aloha motifs, or the bright midday-blue cloudy look; the owner rejected both.
**Don't** add uppercase, letter-spaced kickers or eyebrows above headings.
**Don't** use black or hard-offset shadows; shadows are soft and navy-tinted.
